messages:
maya: heads up, starting a safetensors conversion + TP layout update for the new checkpoint (nova-7b-v2).
maya: raw weights are in s3://redwood-models/onboard/nova7b_v2/raw/ — uploading a small sample shard too.
rui: noted. which TP layout are you targeting? original was TP=2 right?
maya: original trained with tp=2. planning to pack for tp=4 (split along dim 1) and produce 8 shards.
maya: command I'm running locally: ```python tools/convert.py --in s3://... --out /tmp/nova7b_v2 --shards 8 --tp 4 --dtype fp16 --sanitize-tokenizer``` 
dan: quick heads up: we saw a tokenizer quirk last week — BPE models had pad token id set to -1 in metadata, packer expects 0. leads to off-by-one in positions.
maya: thanks, dan. i'll add a sanitize step to rewrite pad->0 and ensure special_tokens_map.json includes eos.
packager-bot: conversion-job 0x7c3 queued -> running: shards=8, tp_layout=[[0,1,2,3],[4,5,6,7]], dtype=fp16
maya: smoke run failed on first tokenization check: tokenizer returned eos id 1 but runtime expects 2. maybe different vocab ordering.
dan: that suggests special_tokens mapping mismatch. also saw "kv cache size" mismatch sometimes when tp stride doesn't align with runtime config.
maya: actual runtime error: "runtime: expected kv size 5120 got 8192" — that looks like a seq_len / kv-dim miscalc.
rui: common cause is config.model.max_seq_len mismatch between model_config.json and runtime_config.yaml or wrong hidden_size split across TP shards.
maya: i'll diff model_config.json vs runtime_config.yaml now.
infra: if it's kv dim related, check shard tensor shapes: first linear layer shapes should have [hidden_dim/TP, ...]. can you paste one failing tensor shape?
maya: pasted sample shape from shard 3: "lm_head.weight: [4096, 12288]" — suspect stride off by 3k.
dan: that lm_head shape looks like it's already combined incorrectly; maybe convert script concatenated TP dims instead of splitting.
maya: ops: will re-run packer with --tp-split-mode=interleave rather than concat.
packager-bot: conversion-job 0x7c3 updated: retrying with --tp-split-mode=interleave
maya: added a tiny CI check locally: run a forward with seq_len=8 and verify kv cache buffer size equals batch*seq_len*kv_dim.
maya: also found that some safetensors writes omitted the .index file when shards are uneven; runtime needs index present.
rui: ensure you call save_index=True in safetensors writer. add a test that loads each shard via safetensors library in CI.
dan: +1 on a small packaging test: tokenization roundtrip for a few sample prompts, and a simple generate to ensure EOS emitted correctly.
maya: ok i'll add tests and update PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/452 — will add -tp4 to filename and include a shard_manifest.json.
rui: LGTM, one nit: name shards as nova7b_v2-tp4-shard-000.safetensors to keep sorting stable.
infra: if CI still fails, ping me with the failing shard id and i'll spin a debug kernel with bf16 fallback.
maya: thanks everyone — re-running now. will mark thread resolved when all smoke checks pass :thumbsup:
packager-bot: conversion-job 0x7c3 succeeded on retry (shards=8, tp=4) :tada:
